name: Kumquat
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as they are low FODMAP and contain minimal fermentable carbohydrates. The small serving size naturally limits potential issues.
preparationTips: Eat whole including the peel for maximum fiber and nutrients
Choose firm, bright orange fruits for best flavor
Can be eaten fresh, candied, or added to salads
Store at room temperature for 2-3 days or refrigerate for up to 2 weeks
